svg.title: Haltiala: daily GPP, Reco and gap-filled NEE (g C m-2 d-1), air temperature, soil water content and precipitation from 2021-05-07 to 2025-12-31, with the recorded management events. A dashed line marks a second date of the same event in another source.
svg.desc: Four panels on one date axis (local time, UTC+2) from 2021-05-07 to 2025-12-31. 1700 days with gap-filled NEE; 61 days with a measured fraction of NEE below 10 % are drawn lighter. Daily GPP from −2.1 to 24.9, Reco from 0.0 to 11.3 and NEE from −17.1 to 9.1 g C m-2 d-1 (NEE < 0 = uptake). 32 recorded events in the period (4 harvest, 11 tillage, 6 sowing, 6 fertilisation, 4 spraying, 1 other), drawn as vertical lines with a type label above panel (a). Largest change of daily GPP near each event: sowing 2021-05-13: GPP rise after sowing on 2021-06-08 (+26 d, clear); harvest 2021-09-10: GPP drop on 2021-09-09 (−1 d, not clear); tillage 2022-04-29: GPP drop on 2022-04-20 (−9 d, not clear); harvest 2022-08-15: GPP drop on 2022-08-05 (−10 d, clear); tillage 2023-08-04: GPP drop on 2023-08-01 (−3 d, clear); tillage 2023-09-08: GPP drop on 2023-09-09 (+1 d, not clear); tillage 2024-05-08: GPP drop on 2024-05-09 (+1 d, clear); tillage 2024-10-10: GPP drop on 2024-10-09 (−1 d, clear); tillage 2025-05-10: GPP drop on 2025-05-08 (−2 d, clear); sowing 2025-06-06: GPP rise after sowing on 2025-06-13 (+7 d, clear); harvest 2025-10-03: GPP drop on 2025-10-01 (−2 d, clear). Spraying 2025-06-16: the xlsx source gives 2025-05-16; no change-point test for this type. Grey bands: thermal growing season, 2021: n/a to 2021-11-18; 2022: 2022-05-01 to 2022-11-14 (197 d); 2023: 2023-04-17 to 2023-10-17 (183 d); 2024: 2024-04-27 to 2024-12-03 (220 d); 2025: 2025-04-13 to 2025-12-21 (252 d). Panel (d) is empty: the site has no precipitation data.
